parameters.content:
## Selection-only staging form

Read-only roster choices from the two Google Sheets. Attach the existing Sheets credential to four readers and dedicated Basic Auth to the trigger after import. Keep inactive. It cannot create campaigns, send messages, publish WordPress posts, or release a static site. DFW-24 and DFW-25 remain excluded.
